text: The System1 Board rejects Brave Bison's formal offer of 30 July 2026 (with improved terms compared to the indicative proposal of 10 July 2026)
Court sanction hearing to be held on 6 August 2026. The scheme is expected to become effective on 13 August 2026
Recommended all share offer (scheme) of 0.190 LondonMetric shares and 0.894 SREIT shares for each Picton share with a total value of 78.7p per share
Deletion: Scheme of arrangement becomes effective
